QuestInfo.name: [Sellas] How to Fix a Radio
QuestInfo.0: You've received a call over the radio from Neinheart in Esfera.
QuestInfo.1:
You're having trouble understanding Neinheart's transmission.
You may want to go to Esfera and talk to him face to face.
QuestInfo.2:
On the way to Esfera's base camp, you ran into Shubert.
Follow him to the base camp.
